import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. # Placeholders: {username}, {title}, {body}, {tags} USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

by {username}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post as sanitized HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title of the post. post_body : str Main content of the post. tags : list[str] List of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string representing the post. """ # Escape user supplied text to avoid XSS or injection safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # body may contain HTML entities but not tags # Render each tag as a element safe_tags = [] for t in tags: # Strip whitespace and escape the tag text cleaned_tag = html.escape(t.strip(), quote=True) if cleaned_tag: # skip empty tags safe_tags.append(f'{cleaned_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(safe_tags) # Format the final HTML rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html ) return rendered.strip()
